name: Skip (formerly Sucasa)
funder: Columbus Capital Pty Ltd (ACN 119 531 252, ACL 337303) trading as Origin Mortgage Management Services, as Product Manager for the Skip Primary Loan; the Skip Secondary Loan is issued by Skip Loans Pty Ltd

assessmentBufferPct.note: Not published. Checked the Skip Primary and Secondary Loan TMDs, the eligibility page, rates page and FAQs — no buffer, floor rate, DTI cap or rent shading is stated. The broker portal at brokers.skiploans.com.au requires a login and was not accessed.

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Skip (Sucasa) — Home loan eligibility, Owner Occupier
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: "Loan to value ratio — Up to 98% LVR". Achieved by pairing a Skip Primary Loan (max 80% LVR) with a Skip Secondary Loan (up to a further 20% LVR). Page is undated; asAt is the date read.

maxLvrInvestmentPct.note: Investor eligibility panel states the same 98% LVR ceiling, but only where the applicant "is buying or refinancing your only investment property".

maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: The rates table shows "LMI $0" at 90%, 95% and 98% LVR; Skip replaces LMI with a capitalised Rate Reduction Fee and a two-loan structure rather than an insurance premium.

value: None — no LMI is charged; the primary/secondary loan structure replaces it

notes.value: Two-loan structure: Skip Primary Loan covers up to 80% of value (min $300,000, max $4,000,000); Skip Secondary Loan covers up to a further 20% (min $20,000, max $1,500,000), taking overall property LVR to between 80% and 100%. Both are principal and interest, variable rate, and are subject to Skip's Accepted Postcode List.
notes.sourceTitle: Target Market Determination for Skip Primary Loan – Variable, TMD v2.1, effective 14 November 2025

notes.value: Target market must be able to "provide sufficient evidence of income or are self-employed and can provide sufficient recent financial information" and hold a satisfactory credit rating. No income-type table, shading percentages or self-employed document standard is published.
notes.sourceTitle: Target Market Determination for Skip Primary Loan – Variable, effective 14 November 2025

minUnitFloorAreaSqm.note: "Properties must be at least 50m2 excluding balconies and car spaces."

highDensityPolicy.value: Owner occupier: cannot lend on apartments in buildings of 7 storeys or more completed after 2014, or on any apartment complex with more than 30 units located in a listed High Density Postcode. Investor: cannot lend on apartments in buildings of 7 storeys or more, or on any apartment within a listed High Density Postcode.
highDensityPolicy.sourceTitle: Skip (Sucasa) — Home loan eligibility, "High Density Restrictions"
highDensityPolicy.note: The high-density postcode list is published separately at https://www.sucasa.com.au/high-density-postcodes.

postcodeRestrictionsPublished.note: Lending is limited to all state capitals plus Newcastle, Wollongong, Central Coast, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Canberra & Queanbeyan and Geelong, with a searchable eligible-postcode list.

postcodeListUrl.sourceTitle: Skip (Sucasa) — Home loan eligibility, "Full Eligible Postcode List"

unacceptablePropertyTypes.note: "New or Established Properties. No vacant land or construction loans." The Primary Loan TMD repeats this exclusion.

minLoanAmount.sourceTitle: Target Market Determination for Skip Primary Loan – Variable, effective 14 November 2025
minLoanAmount.note: "Minimum Loan Size $300,000" on the Primary Loan. The Secondary Loan has its own $20,000 minimum but can only be written alongside a Primary Loan.

maxLoanAmount.sourceTitle: Target Market Determination for Skip Primary Loan – Variable, effective 14 November 2025
maxLoanAmount.note: "Maximum Loan Size (Subject to LVR and postcode policy) $4,000,000" on the Primary Loan; the Secondary Loan caps at $1,500,000.

maxLoanTermYears.sourceTitle: Target Market Determination for Skip Primary Loan – Variable, effective 14 November 2025
maxLoanTermYears.note: Minimum loan term is 20 years and maximum 30 years on both the Primary and Secondary loans.

offsetAvailable.sourceTitle: Target Market Determination for Skip Primary Loan – Variable, effective 14 November 2025
offsetAvailable.note: Ineligible consumers include those who "require an offset account".

redrawAvailable.sourceTitle: Target Market Determination for Skip Primary Loan – Variable, effective 14 November 2025
redrawAvailable.note: Redraw is available on the Primary Loan only; the Secondary Loan has no redraw.

notes.value: Both first home buyers and non-first-home buyers are eligible; no guarantor or equity-sharing arrangement is required. Borrowers must be individuals (single or joint) aged 18 or over. Principal and interest, variable rate only — no fixed rate option. Loan purposes include purchase, refinance, debt consolidation and equity release for a personal purpose. Conditional pre-approval typically takes 24–48 hours.
notes.sourceTitle: Skip (Sucasa) — Home loan eligibility and FAQs

value.conditions: TMD names "NZ citizen" as an eligible borrower class; the visa subclass is not specified.
TMD allows borrowers "on an acceptable visa" / holding "an acceptable visa type"; the list of acceptable subclasses is not published.

rules.sourceTitle: Target Market Determination for Skip Primary Loan – Variable, effective 14 November 2025
rules.note: Quoted: "be an Australian citizen, NZ citizen, permanent Australian resident or on an acceptable visa". The temporary-visa entry is recorded as accepted-with-conditions because the acceptable-visa list is not published; treat it as refer, not pass.

acceptedVisaSubclasses.note: The TMD refers to "an acceptable visa type" but no subclass list is published.

gaps: Sucasa rebranded to Skip in February 2026 — the sucasa.com.au domain still serves the site but all product, portal and broker URLs are now skiploans.com.au. The id 'sucasa' has been kept as the stable join key.

Accepts broker-originated loans: the Primary Loan TMD explicitly lists "Third party – Accredited mortgage brokers subject to Best Interests Duty (BID)" as a distribution channel, and a broker portal exists at brokers.skiploans.com.au (login required, not accessed).

No servicing parameters published at all — this matters more than usual for a 98% LVR lender, since Skip states it is "more conservative than most lenders in terms of who they will lend to" without publishing the criteria.
No income-type table, shading percentages or self-employed document standard.
No credit-history policy published beyond "a satisfactory credit rating".
The Rate Reduction Fee (the LMI substitute) is described as "capitalised" and sized relative to LMI but no fee schedule or formula is published.
The eligible-postcode and high-density-postcode lists are published as interactive lookups; the underlying postcode data was not extracted.
Skip's ABN was not established from the pages read (ACN 106 968 370, ACL 443249 are published).
